title: Log record
description: L-1. One event per record, fixed core fields on every one. This schema is an interface with consumers and versions under the same rules as the API (L-11).

level.description: L-5. An injected fault is warn, not error: it is expected and handled. Errors are for conditions a human must act on, and an error log full of drills stops being read.

schema.description: L-11. Version of this record shape.

trace_id.description: L-2. Generated per poll and propagated to the sensor, so one query returns both sides of an exchange.

reason.description: L-4, C-9. The inputs that drove a decision, structured rather than buried in a message. 'Marked stale: age 47000ms exceeded threshold 15000ms' is auditable; 'sensor returned 200' is not.

seq.description: L-9. Per-producer, strictly increasing by one.

prev_hash.description: L-9. Chains to the previous entry; the first uses GENESIS_HASH.

sig.description: Signed by the producing device, so a compromised journal cannot forge entries in its name.
